approved_payload.content: Police say a man of 26 was found with multiple gunshot wounds in front of a property in Korvette Road, Strandfontein, when officers responded at about 20:45 on Monday 19 October (Lieutenant-Colonel Frederick van Wyk, via Cape Argus and TygerBurger). No source says when he was shot. Strandfontein police registered a murder case; police believe the motive is gang-related. No arrest has been reported. The victim was not named. Two reports, both resting on one police account: TygerBurger and Cape Argus (IOL). Both also describe other Strandfontein shootings on 16 and 17 October; those are not part of this pin.

checked.incident: Mon 19 Oct 2026, found when police responded at about 20:45 (police, via Cape Argus and TygerBurger). 20:45 is the response and discovery time, not a shooting time; no source gives one.
checked.location: In front of a property in Korvette Road, Strandfontein (police, via Cape Argus). House not given. The pin is a street-level marker for Korvette Road (OpenStreetMap), kept where the builder put it on the owner's decision; it marks the road, not any building or house.
checked.method: Found in the 21 Oct 2026 new-signals draft run using the established Sprint 5 Google News queries (window 19-21 Oct); source pages read and claims, dates and place checked by hand, then both re-read, every quote matched word for word and the 12 recorded Sprint 5 query strings re-run on 21 Oct about 15:48 UTC (Batch H); standalone (no case, entity or map line). The other Strandfontein killings in the same reports are not linked.
